bib.title: Depth Anything: Unleashing the Power of Large-Scale Unlabeled Data

question: Can a monocular depth foundation model be built by scaling up with large unlabeled image sets and pseudo labels, even when labeled data is already sufficient?
hypothesis: Unlabeled images, if the student is given a harder target and semantic priors from DINOv2, improve zero-shot generalisation beyond labeled data alone.
contributions: Highlight the value of massive, cheap, diverse unlabeled images for MDE.
Challenge the student with strong perturbations (colour distortion, CutMix) when learning pseudo labels.
Inherit semantic priors from a frozen pre-trained encoder via feature alignment instead of an auxiliary segmentation task.
Stronger zero-shot than MiDaS-BEiT-L-512; fine-tuned with metric depth it outperforms ZoeDepth.

method.summary: Teacher trained on 1.5M labeled images annotates 62M unlabeled images; a re-initialised student trains on both, with CutMix and colour perturbation on unlabeled images and a cosine feature-alignment loss to a frozen DINOv2 encoder. Encoder is then fine-tuned for metric depth and segmentation.
method.task: monocular relative depth estimation (zero-shot), plus metric depth and semantic segmentation transfer

datasets.preprocessing: Depth converted to disparity d=1/t, normalised to 0-1 per map; sky region (from segmentation model) set to disparity 0

other.teacher: best ViT-L teacher annotates unlabeled set

other.training_sets: 12 labeled sets, including NYUv2 and KITTI

training.objective: Affine-invariant MAE loss Ll on labeled, same on pseudo labels with CutMix Lu (weighted by mask area), plus Lfeat = 1 - mean cos(f, f'), skipping pixels with cos > alpha; overall loss is average of Ll, Lu, Lfeat
training.batch_size: labeled:unlabeled = 1:2 per batch; total size not stated for pretraining
training.epochs: teacher 20 epochs; student sweeps all unlabeled images once
training.regularisation: strong colour jitter + Gaussian blur and CutMix (50% probability) on unlabeled images; horizontal flip on labeled; student re-initialised not fine-tuned from teacher

other.metric_finetune: ZoeDepth codebase; 392x518 NYUv2, 384x768 KITTI; encoder lr 1/50 of decoder; batch 16; 5 epochs
other.segmentation_finetune: MMSegmentation, Mask2Former, 896x896, encoder lr 3e-6, decoder 10x; 160K iters ADE20K, 80K Cityscapes, batch 16, no COCO/Mapillary pretraining
other.sky: sky set to disparity 0 using segmentation model [70]
other.failed_aux_segmentation: 4K-class pseudo masks (RAM + GroundingDINO + HQ-SAM) did not help

other.test_resolution: no crop; sides multiples of 14; prediction interpolated to original resolution
other.zero_shot_eval: scale and shift of prediction manually aligned with ground truth

eval.protocol: Zero-shot on six unseen sets; no seeds or significance reported

availability.data: unlabeled/labeled sets are public; pseudo labels not stated

limits: Largest model is ViT-L; ViT-G and resolutions of 700+ left to future work (Sec 8).
Training resolution 518 judged insufficient for real applications.
MiDaS used NYUv2/KITTI training images so those two comparisons are not like for like.
Compute, hardware, batch size of main run, seeds and warmup are not stated; no latency figures; ControlNet benefit shown qualitatively only.
Zero-shot relative evaluation aligns scale and shift to ground truth, so it does not measure metric distance.
